title: Named properties object / named property visibility algorithm with property on Window.prototype
body: When there's a property on `Window.prototype`, the named property visibility algorithm called on `window` will return false in step 5.1, when *prototype* is `Window.prototype`. This implies that [[GetOwnProperty]] on the named properties object will fall back to calling `OrdinaryGetOwnProperty(O, P)`, which returns undefined. However, the browsers I tested consistently return the result of the named getter.
